description.value: Wolf in the Fog is a celebrated ingredient-driven dinner restaurant anchored in the culinary culture of Tofino, BC, named Air Canada enRoute's Canada's Best New Restaurant in 2014. Chef Nicholas Nutting's kitchen draws directly from the surrounding ocean and rainforest — fishing and foraging are central to the menu's identity. The restaurant has sea views from its patio and an extensive, globally curated wine list overseen by a dedicated wine director.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (20 spaces, covered) at 19m; stands (2 spaces) at 23m; stands (4 spaces) at 76m; stands (6 spaces) at 77m. Total: 32 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and active, confirming the business is a real, operating dinner restaurant in Tofino. The website consistently lists the address as '150 Fourth St' across all subpages, contradicting OSM's 'Campbell Street' — I use the website address and flag the discrepancy. The phone number matches: OSM '+12507259653' decodes identically to the website's '250.725.WOLF (9653)'. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, takeout, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all such fields are null.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM records '150 Campbell Street' but the website consistently shows '150 Fourth St, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0' across all pages — OSM street name appears to be incorrect.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, award-winning dinner restaurant in Tofino with an active website and confirmed contact details. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal.

wow_evidence: named Air Canada enRoute's Canada's Best New Restaurant in 2014
